research_projects:
CREATE TABLE `research_projects` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `public_identifier` varchar(190) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `research_title` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `adviser_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `submission_holder_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `workflow_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `revision` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `completed_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `completion_document_id` varchar(40) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `public_identifier` (`public_identifier`),
  UNIQUE KEY `submission_holder_id` (`submission_holder_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `workflow_id` (`workflow_id`),
  KEY `project_adviser_fk` (`adviser_id`),
  KEY `project_final_fk` (`completion_document_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_adviser_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`adviser_id`) REFERENCES `advisers` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_final_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`completion_document_id`) REFERENCES `documents` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_holder_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`submission_holder_id`) REFERENCES `students` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_workflow_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`workflow_id`) REFERENCES `ierb_workflows` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
research_project_identifiers:
CREATE TABLE `research_project_identifiers` (
  `identifier` varchar(190) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `project_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `research_title` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`identifier`),
  KEY `project_identifier_fk` (`project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_identifier_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `research_projects` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
research_project_members:
CREATE TABLE `research_project_members` (
  `project_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `student_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `legacy_identity_json` text NOT NULL,
  `stage_key` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `workflow_revision` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `joined_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`project_id`,`student_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `project_member_student` (`student_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_member_project_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `research_projects` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_member_student_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`student_id`) REFERENCES `students` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_member_snapshot` CHECK (json_valid(`legacy_identity_json`)),
  CONSTRAINT `project_member_stage` CHECK (`stage_key` in ('initial_submission','resubmission_amendment','approval_data_gathering','ierb_completed'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
research_project_events:
CREATE TABLE `research_project_events` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `revision` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `event_key` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `actor_user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `reason` text NOT NULL,
  `evidence_json` longtext NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `project_event_revision` (`project_id`,`revision`),
  KEY `project_event_actor_fk` (`actor_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_event_actor_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_event_project_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `research_projects` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_event_evidence` CHECK (json_valid(`evidence_json`))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
research_project_member_history:
CREATE TABLE `research_project_member_history` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_event_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `project_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `student_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `from_stage` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `to_stage` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `workflow_revision` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `project_member_event` (`project_event_id`,`student_id`),
  KEY `project_history_member_fk` (`project_id`,`student_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_history_event_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`project_event_id`) REFERENCES `research_project_events` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `project_history_member_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`, `student_id`) REFERENCES `research_project_members` (`project_id`, `student_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
